# Gamitofx

> Gamitofx is a Brazilian video editor and motion designer who does retention-first editing for English-speaking educational creators in business, psychology, neuroscience and AI. All work is async and in writing; no calls needed.

## Services (USD)

- Short video (vertical, 30 s to 2 min): $90 per video, 2 revisions, 2–3 business days.
- Long-form video (horizontal, 8 to 15 min): $450 per video, 2 revisions, 5–7 business days.
- Thumbnail (2 versions for A/B testing): $45.
- Channel strategy plan (written audit and a 12-video plan for 12 weeks): $395, one-time, 5 business days.
- Monthly channel strategy (up to 4 long-form videos per month): $400 per month.
- Retention Sprint (paid trial): 3 short videos in 5 days, $225.

## Discounts

- Videos per order: 4–7 save 10%, 8–15 save 15%, 16 or more save 20%.
- Contract length, on top of that: 3 months saves 5%, 6 months 10%, 12 months 15%.
- Every client gets a custom quote.

## Method

- Open on the payoff: the first 3 seconds show the result, not the intro.
- Light up one keyword: captions readable on mute with one highlighted word.
- Change every 2 seconds: a cut, zoom or graphic before attention drops.
